examples.text: Vous êtes l'assistante de Mathias Barneville?

meanings.note: À l'avenir = in the future. Masculine noun ('le avenir', plural 'les avenirs') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'future'.

examples.text: Il s'inquiète pour ton avenir professionnel.

pronoun: c'est = it is; tout ce que = all that

meanings.note: Adjective of capability/quality formed with '-able'/'-ible' (from Latin '-abilis'/'-ibilis'). Prefix 'con-'/'com-' (from Latin 'cum') means 'with, together'.

examples.text: La chambre d'hôtel est calme et confortable.
examples.trans: The hotel room is quiet and comfortable.

meanings.note: Donner un conseil. Prefix 'con-'/'com-' (from Latin 'cum') means 'with, together'. Standard masculine noun meaning 'piece of advice, tip'.

examples.text: Je lui ai donné un petit conseil pour réussir.
examples.trans: I gave her a little tip to succeed.

meanings.note: J'étais dans les sous-vêtements. Core French preposition meaning 'in', linking a noun phrase or infinitive complement to the clause.

meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to freak out'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'flippé').

examples.text: J'ai flippé face à ta jeunesse.

meanings.note: Hésiter à faire quelque chose. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to hesitate'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'hésité').

meanings.note: With ne: je ne mens jamais. Invariable French adverb meaning 'never'; placed immediately after the conjugated verb in simple tenses.
